bio: A leading name in plant-based cuisine in Spain! This famous restaurant, where we are told of a family tradition of hospitality that dates back to 1952, is presented with a refurbished interior in the main room (where there is even a small olive tree), two reserved areas on the upper floor and an attractive terrace. The à la carte, offering a good deal of variety, including traditional dishes, such as stewed snails, as well as a good selection of meat and fish, is supported by two set menus: Business and Degustación de Verduras.
